initiatives.name: Modernize Trade Execution
initiatives.outcome: Cut trade fails and improve fill quality across our top two client segments.
initiatives.hypothesizedValue: Reduces trade breaks and manual intervention, lowering client servicing cost and churn risk.

initiatives.name: Compliance Automation
initiatives.outcome: Pre-trade compliance checks run automatically, with regulatory filings generated, not assembled by hand.
initiatives.hypothesizedValue: Removes a recurring point-solution workaround cost for enterprise clients and closes a gold-tier coverage gap.

initiatives.name: Client Experience Overhaul
initiatives.outcome: Clients self-serve reporting and onboarding instead of waiting on our services team.
initiatives.hypothesizedValue: Improves win rate against best-of-breed reporting competitors in the mid-market and boutique segments.
